kind_rows.choice: Choice column: any of its options, ticked; written as an “is any of” condition.
kind_rows.text: Text column: a text field; written as a “contains” condition.
kind_rows.number: Number column: a minimum and a maximum, either may be empty; written as “is between”.
kind_rows.date: Date column: a first and a last day, either may be empty; written as “is between”.
kind_rows.boolean: Boolean column: yes or no; written as “is yes” or “is no”.
